**3D-Tiled Dataset:** The volume is divided into fixed-size 3D blocks.
Traverse the 3D-tiled dataset using the compact indexing structure.

The object-order phase is $O(B \cdot P)$ where $B$ is blocks and $P$ is pixels, but optimized by culling.
The ray casting phase is proportional to the number of rays and average blocks hit.

*   **When to use:** Interactive visualization of large volumetric datasets on multi-core CPUs where load balancing and memory efficiency are critical.
